# HOME IV AT THE MINNEAPOLIS VA

Minneapolis VA provides home IV therapy contracts with commercial providers. To order home IV antimicrobials:

---

# Step 1

---

An Infectious Disease staff physician must approve outpatient IV antimicrobials in each case. Call x4185, or call the operator on off-tours to contact the ID staff member on-call. If the ID service has been consulted, you must request Home IV approval and recommendations from the ID staff on-call.

---

# Step 2

---

Order a Home IV consult (click on quick order below). Note: Allow 24 hours for home IV service assessment, teaching, etc to occur.

[Home IV consult \(or page 7253\)](gmrctz-home-iv-infusion-coordination)
